tobin_greeting.speaker: Tobin
tobin_greeting.text: Maps, rope, and a few suspiciously useful rocks. What catches your eye?

tobin_maps.speaker: Tobin
tobin_maps.text: This one marks the old road. Half of it is washed out, but the other half still gets you there.

tobin_goodbye.speaker: Tobin
tobin_goodbye.text: Mind the puddles. They are deeper than they look.
